value.answer: Call 911 now. A toddler who is floppy, hard to wake, with sunken eyes and no wet diaper in 12 hours needs emergency care - do not wait or try fluids at home first.
value.triage: Call 911 now, or go to the nearest ER right away if you can get there fast. Health811 (call 811) is for non-emergencies, so do not wait on a nurse call for this.
